item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 31/Oct/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A replenishment of the dry northeast monsoon will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. It will be windy and generally fine over the region. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. An upper-air disturbance will bring a few showers to the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of western Guangdong early next week. Another replenishment of the monsoon is expected to bring slightly cooler weather to southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Kong-rey will turn northwards over Taiwan Strait tomorrow, edging closer to the vicinity of Fujian to Zhejiang. It will then transform into an extratropical cyclone over the East China Sea.
